recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No FHIR core follow-up is needed unless FHIR-I later changes the Resource-root extension policy.
issue_request: FHIR-18342 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-I STU3 correction asking to avoid saying extensions appear on all resources by changing resource to domain resource. The approved resolution instead called for a note, because Resource.meta and other elements may still be extended while direct Resource descendants outside DomainResource cannot have extensions on their root.
initial_application: Jira cites GH#8717c97aa2. Commit 8717c97aa2b58fd58cee885a731fe57ba605819e added the current source/extensibility.html note that resources not specializing DomainResource cannot have root extensions but can have extensions elsewhere through the resource.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini actively maps the Extension type page to extensibility. Current conformance sources continue to match the note: Resource has no root extension element, DomainResource defines extension and modifierExtension, and Bundle directly specializes Resource without a root extension. Later FHIR-43364 and FHIR-46620 clarifications support the same boundary for extension contexts.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. No source hunk is needed because the approved clarification is already present and changing the introductory wording to domain resource would drop the nuance recorded in the Jira resolution.

related_jiras.note: Later Applied/Persuasive with Modification clarification that element contexts can reference resource/datatype roots only where extensions are allowed. It supports the FHIR-18342 distinction and is already represented on the combined branch.

Later Applied/Persuasive clarification that Resource extension context means resources where extensions are allowed, such as DomainResource and descendants. It supports the no-change decision and is already represented on the combined branch.
